items.desc:
The holder has a fixed Attack Speed of @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.:JhinAttackSpeed@, and each @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.:BonusAttackSpeed@% of bonus Attack Speed is converted to @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.:BonusAttackDamage@% Attack Damage.

After summoning 4 Grand Finale Rifles, they begin firing at the same rate as the holder, dealing @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.:RifleADScalar*100@% %i:scaleAD% + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Maestro.:RifleAPScalar*100@% %i:scaleAP% physical damage.

Every 4th volley is Harmonic, and deals @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_Maestro_HarmonicDamage_BatonTooltip*100@% of the damage the holder and their Rifles have done since the last Harmonic volley.
items.name: Maestros Baton

items.desc:
Your team heals a percentage of their max Health every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:Seconds@ seconds.

When a champion dies, they retreat to the sidelines to cheer on your team. Your team's healing increases for each cheering champion.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:BaseHealthRegen@% %i:scaleHealth% base, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:HealthRegenPerMascot@% %i:scaleHealth% per cheering champion
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:BaseHealthRegen@% %i:scaleHealth% base, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:HealthRegenPerMascot@% %i:scaleHealth% per cheering champion
items.name: Mascot

items.desc: Every @Duration@ seconds, revive the strongest ally that hasn't been revived yet at @HPPercent*100@% of their maximum Health.
items.name: Tome of Mending

items.desc:
After @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:FirstDelay@ seconds of combat, the Dragon strikes the board, dealing true damage and stunning all enemies. Allies gain Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:TrueDamageHPRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth% damage, Stuns for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:StunDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:AttackSpeedBuff*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:TrueDamageHPRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth% damage, Stuns for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:StunDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:AttackSpeedBuff*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
After an additional @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:SecondDelay@ seconds, the Dragon strikes again.
items.name: Dragonlord

items.desc:
Gain a spotlight hex.
Combat start: the unit standing in the spotlight gains bonus stats.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:DamagePercent*100@% %i:scaleDA% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:ManaPerSecond@ %i:scaleMana% per second.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:DamagePercent*100@% %i:scaleDA%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:ManaPerSecond@ %i:scaleMana% per second, and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:OmnivampPercent*100@% %i:scaleSV%. Gain another spotlight hex.
items.name: Socialite

items.desc:
Your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:Damage_Reduction*100@% Durability and Damage Amp. For each champion kill, a champion on your team rocks out, increasing this bonus Damage Amp by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.:Kill_Bonus*100@%.

On the @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.:Kill_Count@th kill, your entire team rocks out and gains Attack Speed.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:Bonus_Damage*100@% %i:scaleDA%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.1:Attack_Speed*100@% Attack Speed after a Pentakill.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.2:Bonus_Damage*100@% %i:scaleDA%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pentakill.2:Attack_Speed*100@% Attack Speed after a Pentakill.
items.name: Pentakill

items.desc: Kayle deals @DamageAmpPercent*100@% more damage. When she casts, she fires two waves.
items.name: Tome of Power

items.desc: Kayle deals @DamageAmpPercent*100@% more damage. Her attacks now hit in a @HexRadius@-hex radius around the target
items.name: Tome of Swiftness

items.desc:
Gain 2 Mountain hexes in the front row.
Combat start: units standing on a Mountain hex gain a Shield and permanent bonus Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:ShieldValue@ Shield, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:PermBonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:ShieldValue@ Shield, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:PermBonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%. The entire front row becomes Mountain hexes.
items.name: Mountain

Gain Shimmerscale items. These items give gold as well as combat power.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:MinUnits@) Gain Goldmancers Staff. At Stage @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:SecondItemStage@-@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:SecondItemRound@ gain Draven's Axe.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.2:MinUnits@) Gain Crown of Champions.
items.name: Shimmerscale

items.desc:
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ixtal.1:MinUnits@) Complete Quests to earn Sunshards (%i:Set16Ixtal%) and spend them for loot!
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ixtal.2:MinUnits@) Heal 2 player health at the start of player combat. Find @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Ixtal.2:BonusClues@ %i:Set16Ixtal% at the end of combat, and you can now unlock Brock after reaching 500 %i:Set16Ixtal%!

Completing a Quest before combat ends grants you a new one at the start of next round.

Total Sunshards Earned: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Explorer_TotalExplorerPoints@ %i:Set16Ixtal%
items.name: Ixtal

items.desc:
Summon the Nocturnus to aid you in battle! It fires a rocket that deals @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:BaseRocketDamage@ magic damage every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:BaseDamageThreshold@ damage your team deals.

2-cost and higher champions become Crew members after reaching 3-star. Gain additional bonuses for each Crew member.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:MinUnits@) 2 max Crew members.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.2:MinUnits@) 4 maximum Crew members.

(1x %i:3StarEnabled%): + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:OnARollRolls@ free rerolls when you star up a unit you fielded last combat.
(2x %i:3StarEnabled%): Rockets deal @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:UpgradedRocketDamage@ damage.
(3x %i:3StarEnabled%): + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:FreeRerollsPerRound@ free reroll / round.
(4x %i:3StarEnabled%): Rockets fire every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:UpgradedDamageThreshold@ damage dealt. Gain @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_TheCrew.1:XPPerRound@ XP per round.
items.name: The Crew

items.desc:
Your team gains Bees that deal magic damage to their targets every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy:Period@ seconds. Bee damage is based on the damage dealt and taken by the host, plus a flat amount per Bee.

When a unit dies, they leave @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy:NumTransfers@ bees that follow nearby allies for the rest of combat.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:MiniCount@ Bees, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:BonusDamage*100@% Damage dealt, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:DamageReceived*100@% damage taken, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.1:DamagePerMini@ damage per Bee.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:MiniCount@ Bees, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:BonusDamage*100@% Damage dealt, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:DamageReceived*100@% damage taken, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Honeymancy.2:DamagePerMini@ damage per Bee.
items.name: Honeymancy

items.desc:
Your team's takedowns grant stacks of Conquest. After gaining enough Conquest, open War Chests full of loot!

Your team gains Attack Damage and Ability Power, increased by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror:PercentIncreasePerChest*100@% for each War Chest opened.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:StacksPerKill@x Conquest
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:StacksPerKill@x Conquest

War Chests Opened: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror_ChestsCompleted@
Current Stats: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror_CurrentADAP@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
items.name: Conqueror

items.desc:
Your team gain bonus Health, Attack Damage and Ability Power, which increases by 1% every time you spend gold on a Shop reroll.

After each combat, gain a 1 gold reroll for that round. Your first reroll each round grants @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk:FIRST_ROLL_BONUS@% bonus instead!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

Current Bonus: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentBonus@%
@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentHealthBonus@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentADBonus@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
items.name: Punk

items.desc:
Summon a Hero named Kayle and evolve her as you level up!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.1:MinUnits@) When you reach level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FirstArmoryLevel@, Kayle upgrades to 2-star. Pick a supportive effect.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.2:MinUnits@) Kayle evolves again at levels @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@ and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@:
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@: Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 3-star. Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 4-star.
items.name: Storyweaver

items.desc:
Gain a Glacial Mallet. Attacks from champions holding a mallet have a @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:ProcPercent*100@% chance to stun their target for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:StunDuration@ second and deal bonus magic damage.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:BonusDamage@ magic damage.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:BonusDamage@ magic damage. Gain another Glacial Mallet.
items.name: Glacial

items.desc:
Use the Pilot Selector to choose a Pilot. Combat start: the Pilot jumps into a Mech.

The Mech has the traits and items of its Pilot, and gains a percent of the pilot's Attack Damage and max Health. When the Mech dies, the Pilot(s) are ejected with @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:EjectedPilotHealthPercent@% of their max Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:MinUnits@) Mini-Mech: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:MechCombinedADRatio*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.2:MinUnits@) Super-Mech: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.2:MechCombinedADRatio*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%. The 2 nearest units to the Pilot also jump into the Mech.
items.name: Mech-Pilot

items.desc:
Your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:BaseASPct@% %i:scaleAS% Attack Speed.

For each kill, your team creates an infernal cinder that you collect the next round. For every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:NumCinders@ cinders you collect, your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:ASPctPerNumCinders@% more %i:scaleAS%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.1:NumCindersPerKill@ infernal cinder per enemy.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:NumCindersPerKill@ infernal cinders per enemy and execute enemies under @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:ExecutePct@% Health.

Cinders collected: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_PyroCindersCollected@
Team %i:scaleAS%: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_PyroAttackSpeed@%
items.name: Pyro

items.desc:
For each active trait, your team gains bonus Health and Damage Amp.
(Excludes unique and Anniversary Traits)

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:BonusHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:BonusHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%

Bonus Health: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT10_Trait_Jazz_TraitTracker_CurrentBonus@%
Bonus Damage Amp: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT10_Trait_Jazz_TraitTracker_CurrentBonus_Damage@%

items.name: Overlord Selector

items.desc:
Each time your team loses @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:MaxHealthLost*100@% max Health, they Rally, reducing their Mana cost by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:ManaReductionPct*100@%. Your team gains Armor and Magic Resist.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.1:ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:ArmorMR@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%. Unlock Galio. On Rally, reduce Mana costs of your team by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:ManaReductionPctPerGalioItem*100@% for each item equipped to your strongest Galio, and smite enemies for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Demacia.2:EnemyTrueDamage*100@% of their max Health.
items.name: Demacia

items.desc:
Your team gains a Shield and Damage Amp for each adjacent ally.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:ShieldAmount@ Shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:ShieldDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:ShieldAmount@ Shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:ShieldDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA%
items.name: Rebel

items.desc: Grant Kayle and adjacent allies in the same row @APAmt@ Ability Power.

items.desc:

ability.desc: Field Miss Fortune to choose whether she activates Conduit Mode, Challenger Mode, or Replicator Mode. The chosen mode determines her ability and her trait.

Reposition next to the target to strike the most enemies. Then throw @NumShurikens@ piercing kunai, each dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the first enemy hit, reduced to @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) for each subsequent target. Summon a flying saucer over the current target that lasts @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. Each second it deals @ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target, plus @ModifiedSplitDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between all enemies within @SecondaryHexRange@ hex. The saucer deals @TankDamageIncrease*100@% increased damage to Tanks.

If an enemy under the UFO dies, Bard has a @AbductChance*100@% chance to abduct them and create a 1-star copy on your bench.

Hacked enemies store @HexPercent*100@% of all damage they take. When the Hack ends, they take true damage equal to the stored damage. The Hack ends early if it would kill the target.

ability.desc:
Passive: Every 5th attack, launch a returning boomerang at the target that travels two hexes past the first enemy it hits. It deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit*100@% per hit.

Strafe to a nearby position, unleashing @BaseMissiles@ missiles split between the target and all enemies within two hexes. Passive: Immune to crowd control effects. Attacks briefly knock up the target and deal @PassivePercentAoE*100@% damage in a 1 hex radius around them.

Active: Slam the ground, dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to ALL enemies, reduced by @EffectReductionPerHex*100@% for each hex from the center (down to @EffectReductionMinimum*100@%.) If this is the first time they've been hit by Seismic Slam this combat, knock them up for up to @StunDuration@ seconds. @NumRocks@ rocks fall around the battlefield, each dealing @ModifiedRockDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit.
ability.name: Seismic Slam

ability.desc: Combat start: H4kerr!m picks up the unit in the rider hex and then charges directly forward into the enemy backline.
ability.name: Infiltration

ability.desc:
Passive: For every @PercentMissingHealth@% missing Health, gain @ModifiedAS@% (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed

Active: Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target, increased by @PercentBonusDamage*100@% if they're a tank.
ability.name: Fish Frenzy

ability.desc: Unleash a flurry of <TFTBonus>@TotalNumSlashes@ (%i:scaleAS%)</TFTBonus> slashes at the current target over @SlashDuration@ seconds, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage each.
ability.name: Tidal Slashes

ability.desc: Field Miss Fortune to choose whether she activates Conduit Mode, Challenger Mode, or Replicator Mode. The chosen mode determines her ability and her trait.
ability.name: Gun Goddess Arsenal

ability.desc:
Reposition next to the target to strike the most enemies. Then throw @NumShurikens@ piercing kunai, each dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the first enemy hit, reduced to @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) for each subsequent target. Kunai remove @ArmorShred@ Armor, @ArmorShredCrit@ if they crit.

N.O.V.A. Strike: Slice all enemies, applying Wound and a bleed that deals @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each second. Kunai increase the damage of the bleed by @NovaShurikenBonusDamage*100@%.
ability.name: Star Strike

ability.desc:
Summon a flying saucer over the current target that lasts @AugmentedDuration@@Duration@ seconds. Each second it deals @ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target, plus @ModifiedSplitDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between all enemies within @SecondaryHexRange@ hex. The saucer deals @TankDamageIncrease*100@% increased damage to Tanks.

If an enemy under the UFO dies, Bard has a @AbductChance*100@% chance to abduct them and create a 1-star copy on your bench.

Meep bonus: On combat start, grant the nearest @ModifiedNumAllies@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meeple allies an additional Meep.

Friends abducted: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_Bard_FriendsAbducted@
ability.name: Ultra Friendly Object

ability.desc: Fire a barrage of <TFTBonus>@ModifiedNumRockets@ (%i:scaleAS%)</TFTBonus> rockets in a cone, each dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the first target hit.
ability.name: Explosive Attitude

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @Duration@ seconds. Over the duration, drain <trueDamage>@ModifiedHealthDrain@ (%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> Health from the nearest @NumEnemies@ enemies. Then slam down, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes.
ability.name: Test of Spirit

ability.desc:
Open a @SpellHexRadius@ hex rift containing the target, Hacking enemies within for @HexDuration@ seconds and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each, plus @ModifiedSplitDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage split between all enemies hit.

Hacked enemies store @HexPercent*100@% of all damage they take. When the Hack ends, they take true damage equal to the stored damage. The Hack ends early if it would kill the target.
ability.name: Hopped-Up Hacks

ability.desc:
Passive: Every @NumAttacks@ attacks, reveal a Vital on the target. If a Vital exists, dash to attack it dealing @ModifiedVitalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus true damage and heal for @PercentHealing*100@% of the damage dealt.

Active: Reveal @NumVitals@ Vitals on the target and quickly attack them all. If the target dies, remaining Vitals transfer to the nearest enemy. Upon striking the final Vital, create a two hex aura that heals allies within for @ModifiedHealing@ (%i:scaleAP%) over @AuraDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Perfect Bladework

ability.desc:
Passive: Every 5th attack, launch a returning boomerang at the target that travels two hexes past the first enemy it hits. It deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit*100@% per hit.

Meep Bonus: @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meeps attack alongside Gnar, dealing @ModifiedMeepDPS@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAS%) physical damage per second.
ability.name: Slingshot Maneuver

ability.desc:
Dash through the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Every third cast also summons a Mega Meep after a delay, briefly knocking the target up and dealing @ModifiedChompDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:set14AmpIcon%) magic damage. Adjacent enemies take @SecondaryDamage*100@% damage.

Meep Bonus: Add @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) Meep to the bait, increasing Mega Meep damage by @ModifiedMeepBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%).
ability.name: Meep Bait

ability.desc:
Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then, strike enemies in a three hex line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%) magic damage.

Meep Bonus: Reduce the damage of incoming attacks by @ModifiedFlatDR@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%). After being attacked @AttacksPerPassiveTrigger@ times, deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:set14AmpIcon%) magic damage in a two hex radius.
ability.name: Gravitational Spin

ability.desc:
Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. For the duration, allies within two hexes gain @ModifiedResists@ (%i:scaleAP%) Armor and Magic Resistance.

Meep Bonus: Meeps grant @ModifiedMeepShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield to the nearest @ModifiedNumMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) allies for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Huddle Up!

ability.desc:
Strafe to a nearby position, unleashing @BaseMissiles@ missiles split between the target and all enemies within two hexes. Missiles deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage with a @ProcChance@% Lucky chance of firing a mega missile that deals @ModifiedProcDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) instead.

Meep Bonus: Every @ModifiedMeepCooldown@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) seconds, launch an Explosive Meep at the target, dealing @ModifiedMeepDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage in a one hex radius on impact.

Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.
ability.name: Asteroid Blaster

ability.desc:
Call down a Meepteor on the target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Meep Bonus: An additional @ModifiedMiniMeeps@ (%i:set14AmpIcon%) mini Meepteor are called down on nearby targets dealing @ModifiedMiniDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage each.
ability.name: Meepteor Shower

ability.desc:
Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%), then deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage to the current target.

N.O.V.A. Strike: Cleave the battlefield, briefly knocking up all enemies and dealing @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage.
ability.name: Stellar Slash

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks have a @ProcChance@% Lucky chance to fire an empowered Headshot, dealing @ModifiedHeadshotDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.

N.O.V.A. Strike: Mark all enemies, increasing damage taken by @NovaMarkDamageAmp*100@%. The first time marked targets drop below @NovaMarkThreshold*100@% Health, Headshot them for @ModifiedNovaHeadshotDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.

Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.
ability.name: Aim For The Head

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @PassiveRatio*100@% more max Health from all sources.

Active: Converge an X-shape of vines on the target, dealing @DamageTotal@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each enemy hit and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

N.O.V.A. Strike: Send forth a wave of dragons that stun all enemies for @NovaStunDuration@ seconds. For the rest of combat, Maokai's attacks deal @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%) bonus physical damage.
ability.name: Grasp of Convergence

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks and Abilities mark the target. When an enemy reaches @MaxMarks@ marks, Wolf consumes the marks, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.

Active: Jump up to @HexDistance@ hex away and fire arrows at the nearest @NumTargets@ targets, each dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

N.O.V.A. Strike: Gain @NovaDamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp. Now and every @NovaRepeatTimer@ seconds after, add a mark to all enemies.
ability.name: Cosmic Pursuit

ability.desc:
Passive: On takedown, gain @ManaPerKill@ mana.

Active: Fire @BaseNumMissiles@ missiles in a @HexRange@-hex radius around the current target, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each.
ability.name: Bullet Cluster

ability.desc: Gather the force of a black hole, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage split between the target and the <scaleLevel>@NumEnemies@</scaleLevel> closest enemies to them. The target takes an additional <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Singularity

ability.desc:
Passive: Jhin has a fixed attack speed of @FixedAS@ and converts every @PercentBonusASToConvert*100@% of bonus Attack Speed into @ADConversionRate@ bonus Attack Damage.

Active: Summon @NumHands@ spectral hands that fire alongside Jhin for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. Each hand deals @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage per shot. The final shots deal @FinalShotPercentDamageIncrease*100@% more damage and pierce through the most enemies in a line, dealing @PercentDamageReductionPerTargetHit*100@% reduced damage per target hit.
ability.name: Space Opera

ability.desc:
Passive - Proximity Blast: Whenever an enemy enters a @ShotgunRange@ (%i:scaleRange%) hex radius, fire a blast in a cone towards the closest adjacent hex that deals @ModifiedShotgunDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage with @FalloffPerHex*100@% falloff per hex. Each adjacent hex has a @ShotgunCooldown@ second cooldown, and starts combat on cooldown.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and reposition up to one hex to maximize the number of targets within Proximity Blast's radius. Reset Proximity Blast's cooldowns.
ability.name: Unstoppable Dreadnought

ability.desc: Channel a deathbeam in a line towards the current target for <ShowIf.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active><TFTRadiantItemBonus>@AugmentedDuration@</TFTRadiantItemBonus></ShowIf.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active><ShowIfNot.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active>@Duration@</ShowIfNot.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active> seconds. It deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage per second, reduced by @DamageReductionPerTarget*100@% per enemy it passes through. Deathbeam ignores @MagicPen*100@% of the enemy's Magic Resist.
ability.name: Deathbeam

ability.desc: Enter a defensive stance for @DurabilityDuration@ seconds gaining <TFTBonus>@Durability*100@% </TFTBonus>Durability. While in the defensive stance, attract nearby enemy projectiles and heal <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth> over the duration. When this ends, release a shockwave that deals <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%)</physicalDamage> as physical damage in a @HexRange@-hex range.
ability.name: Gravity Matrix

ability.desc: Channel a one-hex psionic storm that follows enemies for <ShowIf.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active><TFTRadiantItemBonus>@AugmentedDuration@</TFTRadiantItemBonus></ShowIf.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active><ShowIfNot.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active>@Duration@</ShowIfNot.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active> seconds. Each second, it grows larger and deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies within, reduced by @FalloffPerHex*100@% per hex from the epicenter.
ability.name: Psionic Storm

ability.desc: Reposition up to one hex to throw a harpoon at the furthest enemy. The harpoon pulls the first enemy hit one hex forward and deals <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage. Then, teleport behind them and cleave, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to them and <physicalDamage>@ModifiedAreaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to nearby enemies.
ability.name: Marked for Death

ability.desc:
Passive: Every third attack is a doubleslash that deals @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage.

Active: After brief meditation, enter a Psi-State for @Duration@ seconds, gaining @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed, and increased movement speed. Twice a second, fire a psychic projection at a random nearby enemy that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage
ability.name: Psi Strikes

ability.desc:
Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) over @Duration@ seconds. Then, deal @DamageTotal@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to target and enemies adjacent to them and @ASSlow*100@% Chill them for @CCDuration@ seconds.

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}
ability.name: Chemical Rage

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedHitDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage and an additional @ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) stacking magic damage over @PoisonDuration@ seconds. While an enemy has @GrooveStacks@ or more stacks, Teemo is in {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}}.

Active: Gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @ActiveAttacks@ attacks.
ability.name: Double Time

ability.desc: Transform for @Duration@ seconds, temporarily gaining <scaleLevel>@MaxHealth@</scaleLevel> max Health, entering {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}}, and dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies each second.
ability.name: Groovin' Susan

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal magic damage. Gwen is in {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} while targeting an enemy below @GrooveThreshold*100@% Health.

Active: Dash to a nearby hex to snip the lowest percent Health enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target and @ModifiedAreaDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies in a cone. If this kills, dash and snip again at @ResetDamage*100@% damage!
ability.name: Dance n' Dice

ability.desc:
Passive: Whenever an enemy is knocked up, shoot them, dealing @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage and entering {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.

Active: Unleash a volley of bullets at the target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and knocking up for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Jump and Jive

ability.desc:
Passive: On combat start, forge a temporary completed item. If 3 items are already equipped, a random completed item becomes Radiant this combat instead.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, then breath fire in a cone dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. After any Shield on Ornn expires, Ornn enters {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Disco Inferno

ability.desc: Toss a disco bubble at the target that deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> split between enemies in a one hex radius. The explosion sends @NumProjectiles@ globs towards nearby enemies that deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedFirstBounceDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. On cast, Nami enters {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Bubble Pop

ability.desc:
Passive: Every @BoltCooldown@ seconds, call down a bolt on the highest Health nearby enemy that deals @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

Active: Summon a disco ball at the largest clump of enemies, then knock up the current target into it, dealing @ModifiedUppercutDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. They crash down into the disco ball, dealing @ModifiedExplosionDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a three hex radius. Enter {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for @GrooveDurationPerTarget@ second per enemy hit.
ability.name: Party Crasher

ability.desc:
Hurl a chunk of magnetic debris at the nearest target without one, dealing @ModifiedDebrisDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and sticking it to them. If an enemy with debris dies, it passes to the nearest enemy without one.

Every @NumCasts@ casts, instead rip off all debris dealing @ModifiedDebrisRipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, then crush all the debris onto the target, dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and briefly stunning them.
ability.name: Psionic Crush

ability.desc:
Draw a card with a value between 1 and 9 by Lucky chance, then throw it at the target. Based on the card drawn, deal between @ModifiedDamageMin@ (%i:scaleAP%) and @ModifiedDamageMax@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Overkill damage bounces to the nearest enemy.

If a 9 is thrown, generate 1 gold. If a 1 is thrown, take @MaxHealthDamage*100@% max health true damage.

Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.
ability.name: Fate's Gambit

ability.desc: Stab the target, causing them to bleed for <physicalDamage>@ModifiedBleedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. After the attack, leap to the highest percent Health enemy within @HexDistance@ hexes.
ability.name: Diviner's Judgment

ability.desc: Enter a defensive stance for @Duration@ seconds, reducing incoming damage by <TFTBonus>@ModifiedFlatDR@</TFTBonus> and gaining <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield. When the stance ends, strike all nearby enemies, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%)</magicDamage> magic damage and Stunning them for <scaleLevel>@StunDuration@</scaleLevel> second(s).
ability.name: Counter Star-ike

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain a different secondary effect each game based on the Stargazer constellation.

Active: Call down something from the sky, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to @NumEnemies@ nearby enemies and do some special effect based on this game's Stargazer Constellation.
ability.name: It's Raining Stars

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Summon an astrolabe to crash down on a nearby hex, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedInitialDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes. Then, push the astrolabe towards the end of the board, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedFollowupDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. All enemies hit by the astrolabe are knocked up for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Calamity

ability.desc:
Passive: Every time Vex attacks, Shadow strikes a nearby enemy, dealing @ModifiedShadowHandDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Whenever an enemy is struck @NumStrikesForPassive@ times by Shadow, Shadow strikes them again.

Active: Shadow launches @NumActiveStrikes@ empowered strikes, dealing @ModifiedShadowHandMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.
ability.name: Lend Me a Hand, Shadow!

ability.desc:
Passive: This Ability adapts to Attack Damage or Ability Power, whichever is higher. Attacks deal @ModifiedPassiveAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedPassiveADDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

Active: Dash to a nearby hex, gaining @Shield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and slashing adjacent enemies for @ModifiedAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedADDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Every third cast, leap into the air and launch a wave of energy that deals @ModifiedAPWaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic@ModifiedADWaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies in a line.
ability.name: Time Warp

ability.desc:
Passive: On cast, attacks gain @ModifiedBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) stacking bonus magic damage. Starting from the third cast, gain true damage instead.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, then slice open a rift on the largest group of champions dealing the Passive's bonus damage to all enemies within. Enemies have their Attack Speed slowed by @ASSlow*100@% while allies within gain @BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed, both rapidly decaying over @BuffDebuffDuration@ seconds. Shen always gains his rift's full bonus for this duration.
ability.name: Reality Tear

ability.desc:
Kick a ball at the current target that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. On impact, the ball has a 100% Lucky chance to bounce to a new target dealing @ModifiedBounceDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. These bounces can trigger additional bounces, but the odds halve with each bounce.

Milio has a 40% chance to cast an additional time at an additional target. Bonus casts can trigger more bonus casts.

Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.
ability.name: Mega Time Kick

ability.desc:
Active: Fire a blast at the current target that deals @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage. Every @TakedownsToDrone@ takedowns, gain a drone that deals @ModifiedDroneDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the current target on cast.
(Total Takedowns: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_Ezreal_Takedowns@)
ability.name: Temporal Shot

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Bash the current target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%)</magicDamage> magic damage and stunning them for <scaleLevel>@StunDuration@</scaleLevel> seconds.
ability.name: Shield of Daybreak

ability.desc: Fire a paddle star at the current target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the first target hit and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) to others it passes through. When the missile reaches its destination, redirect it to a distant enemy, increasing its speed and repeating the damage. This redirect can occur @AugmentedNumRedirects@@NumRedirects@ times.
ability.name: Paddle Star

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedBonusDamageToAttacks@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield and summon 3 encircling orbs for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Orbs deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies they pass through, and rotate faster based on Attack Speed.
ability.name: Pale Cascade

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedBaseAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.

Active: Summon @NumClones@ clones that attack alongside for @NumAttacks@ attacks, dealing @CloneDamageMultiplier*100@% damage. For their final attack, clones fire a bolt that deals @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.
ability.name: Fracture Reality

ability.desc:
Deal @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%)  magic damage to the lowest Health enemy in range and permanently gain @BonusHealthPerCast@ maximum Health. If this kills them, permanently gain @BonusHealthOnKill@ maximum Health instead.

(Current Bonus: +@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT17_ChoGathBonusHealth@ Health)
ability.name: Accretion

ability.desc: Hurl a shard towards the current target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to the first target it hits. After hitting its initial target or at its final destination, the dagger explodes dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to nearby targets.
ability.name: Dark Matter

ability.desc: Create a clone behind the target with @HPPenalty*100@% reduced max Health and @ManaCostIncrease@ increased Mana cost. The clone inherits its creator's items, stats, and current Health, and can cast Quantum Clone.
ability.name: Quantum Clone

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @ModifiedAADamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and grant allies @BonusAP@% Ability Power for the rest of combat.
ability.name: Screech

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks deal @TotalBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:set14AmpIcon%) bonus magic damage.

Active: Leap to largest group of enemies within @LeapHexRange@ hexes and slam the ground, dealing @DamageTotal@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a three hex radius, reduced by @FalloffPerHex*100@% per hex from the epicenter. The closest @EnemiesKnockedUp@ enemies are knocked up for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Meep Bonus: The passive's bonus damage is increased by @BonusDamagePerMeep*100@% per Meep.
ability.name: The Big Bang

ability.desc: Field Miss Fortune to choose whether she activates Conduit Mode, Challenger Mode, or Replicator Mode. The chosen mode determines her ability and her trait.
ability.name: Gun Goddess Arsenal

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedInitialShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield. Each second for the next <ShowIf.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active><TFTRadiantItemBonus>@AugmentedDuration@</TFTRadiantItemBonus></ShowIf.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active><ShowIfNot.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active>@Duration@</ShowIfNot.TFT17_Augment_Concentration_Active> seconds, gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldPerProc@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> more Shield and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamagePerProc@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies. When this ability ends, consume the remaining Shield and heal for <scaleHealth>@HealRefund*100@%</scaleHealth> of its value.
ability.name: Indestructible

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks bounce to strike @AttackNumEnemies@ times, dealing @PassivePercentReducedDamage*100@% reduced damage per target hit and leaving a Feather behind the final target.

Active: Gain @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. At the end, recall all Feathers split between the closest @RecallFeatherTargets@ enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each. Xayah's current target takes @ModifiedPrimaryTargetBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) additional physical damage per feather.
ability.name: Stellar Ricochet

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks fire @NumProjectiles@ projectiles in a cone that deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ (%i:TFTBaseAD%) physical damage each.

Active: Fire an explosive shell that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to the target, and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to adjacent enemies.
ability.name: Collateral Damage

ability.desc:
Passive: Once per combat after dropping below @HPThreshold*100@% Health, gain Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds equal to @PercentHealingToShield*100@% of healing received this combat.

ability.desc: Deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage spread amongst the target and all enemies within a 1-hex radius, plus <magicDamage>@ModifiedCenterBonusMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> bonus magic damage to the target.
ability.name: Watch Out!

ability.desc: Shoot a tendril towards the current target, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedPhysicalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for <scaleLevel>@StunDuration@</scaleLevel> seconds. It then spreads to @SpreadCount@ nearby enemies, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage and Stunning them for the same duration.
ability.name: Chain of Constellations

ability.desc:
Kick the target, Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds and knocking them back. The target and all enemies hit take @ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. 20% Shred damaged enemies for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

{{TFT_Keyword_Shred}}
ability.name: Dragon's Rage

ability.desc: Shen creates a zone around himself for @ZoneDuration@ seconds, in which all nearby allies dodge physical damage. While it's active, Shen gains @ModifiedMR@ Magic Resist.
ability.name: Flame's Refuge

ability.desc:
Elise transforms into Spider Form for the rest of combat, reducing her Attack Range to 1 and replacing her ability with Venomous Bite, which she immediately casts.

Venomous Bite: Elise's next attack deals @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage. If this kills her target she ascends, becoming untargetable before dropping near the lowest Health enemy and immediately casting Venomous Bite again.
ability.name: Spider Form

ability.desc: Volibear rages, gaining <scaleHealth>@ModifiedBonusHealth@</scaleHealth> bonus Health. For the rest of combat, every @NumAttacks@rd attack deals <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamagePerTarget@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> bonus magic damage to the target, and <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamagePerTarget@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to up to @NumTargets@ additional enemies.
ability.name: Relentless Storm

ability.desc:
Passive: Permanently gain @StackingAD@% %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage after each death. (Current Bonus: @TFTUnitProperty.unit:TFT7_OlafPassiveBonusAD@% %i:scaleAD% Attack Damage.)

Active: Deal @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and gain @ModifiedAttackSpeedRatio@ (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed for @BuffDuration@ seconds. If below @HealthPercentThreshold@% Health, the Attack Speed is doubled.
ability.name: Recklessness

ability.desc: Ryze hurls @NumOfOrbs@ arcane orb at his target, dealing <scaleAP>@SingleOrbDamage@</scaleAP> magic damage (@ModifiedPercentMana@%%i:scaleAP% maximum Mana %i:scaleMana%). Each cast increases his maximum Mana by @ManaIncrease@ and the number of orbs thrown by @OrbIncrease@.
ability.name: Overload

ability.desc: Enchant the <scaleLevel>@NumTargets@</scaleLevel> closest allies or enemies. Enchanted allies gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedAttackSpeedPercent@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> bonus Attack Speed for @AllyBuffDuration@ seconds. Enchanted enemies are <TFTKeyword>Stunned</TFTKeyword> and transformed into a docile feline for @PolymorphDuration@ seconds, taking @DamageAmp@% increased damage.
ability.name: Whimsy

ability.desc: Ornn summons an elemental that charges towards Ornn through the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies hit and slowing their Attack Speed by 50% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. When the elemental reaches Ornn he redirects it towards another distant enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies hit and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Stampede

ability.desc:
Transform into a dragon for the rest of combat and replace this ability with Flame Breath. Become briefly untargetable and dive-bomb into the largest group of enemies, dealing @ModifiedInitialDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a 3-hex circle and Stunning for @StunDuration@ seconds. After landing, cast Flame Breath immediately.

Flame Breath: Breathe fire in a cone, dealing up to @ModifiedFlameBreathDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies hit. While breathing fire, is always enraged.
ability.name: Dragon's Descent

ability.desc: Summon spectral riders that charge through the target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage and <TFTKeyword>Stunning</TFTKeyword> enemies hit for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Onslaught of Shadows

ability.desc:
Passive: While any ally is below @HealthThreshold@% Health, gain an additional @ManaPerAttack@ mana per attack.

Active: Call down a shower of @stars@ stars over the next @Duration@ seconds. Allies are healed for @ModifiedHealing@ (%i:scaleAP%) each time a star hits them.
ability.name: Starfall

ability.desc: Fire a burst of energy towards the current target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage in a 1-hex radius centered on the first enemy hit.
ability.name: Inner Flame

ability.desc: Heimerdinger lobs an egg at the highest percent Health enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Egg Toss

ability.desc: Tristana fires up to @NumOfCharges@ explosive charges, prioritizing the closest targets without a charge. Charges detonate after @Duration@ seconds, dealing <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@PercentAD*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%) to nearby enemies and an additional @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the target.
ability.name: Explosive Charge

ability.desc: Anivia summons a prismatic storm around her target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Enemies in the storm have their Magic Resist reduced by 40%.
ability.name: Prismatic Storm

ability.desc: Talon stealths for @StealthDuration@ seconds and flings out a ring of blades, dealing <scaleAD>@SecondaryTotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@SecondaryRatio*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%) to enemies hit. He then leaps to the farthest enemy within 4 hexes and recalls the blades, dealing that damage again and dealing <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@ADRatio*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedBaseDamage@) to his target.
ability.name: Shadow Assault

ability.desc: Illaoi slams her idol into the ground, summoning @Tentacles@ tentacles that lash out, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies in a cone. Illaoi steals @ResistStealPercent@% Armor and Magic Resist from each enemy hit for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Cosmic Lash

ability.desc:
Each Combat: Neeko disguises herself as the nearest allied champion, adding their bonus Attack Damage and Attack Speed to her own and copying all other stats except Health. She then gains a shield for @ModifiedShieldBase@ plus @HealthRatio*100@% of her ally's Health.

When the shield breaks, she transforms into Neeko Form, reverts back to her own stats, and casts Pop Blossom, dealing @ModifiedMagicDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Neeko then casts Pop Blossom each time she reaches maximum mana.

ability.desc: Nab an Ability from another dimension and cast it.
ability.name: Spell Thief

ability.desc:
Gain @ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and dash through the target, slashing nearby enemies for @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

Every third cast the slash deals @EmpoweredDamagePct@% damage, hits a larger area, and Stuns enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds. If only one enemy remains, repeatedly slash them until they die.
ability.name: Sweeping Blade

ability.desc: Corki launches a barrage of @NumMissiles@ missiles at his target, each dealing <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@PercentAttackDamage*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%). The final missile is instead The Big One and deals <scaleAD>@TotalBigDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@BigPercentAttackDamage*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedMagicDamage@) in a large area.
ability.name: Missile Barrage

ability.desc: Bite the target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. If the target has less Health than Nunu & Willump prior to the bite, deal an additional @DamageAmp*100@% damage.
ability.name: Consume

ability.desc: Stun the largest group of enemies for <scaleLevel>@StasisDuration@</scaleLevel> seconds. While Stunned, enemies lose <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamageAmpRatio@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> Durability. If at least one enemy is struck, Bard dances.
ability.name: Tempered Fate

ability.desc: Daisy smashes the ground around her target, dealing @TooltipDaisyDamage@ magic damage.
ability.name: Smash

ability.desc: Jinx summons a line of traps centered on her target. Traps detonate after a brief delay, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and stunning enemies hit for @StunDuration@ second(s). Jinx gains @ManaRefund@ mana for each empty trap.
ability.name: Flame Chompers

ability.desc: Kayn sweeps his scythe in a line through his target, dealing <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@ADRatio*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%) to all enemies and an additional @ModifiedBonusDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit.

For @Duration@ seconds, attacks leave a feather behind the target and @NumBonusAttacks@ nearby enemies.

At the end of this duration, recall all feathers, dealing @ModifiedPullbackDamagePerFeather@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage per feather to enemies struck.

ability.desc:

{{TFT_Keyword_Disarm}}

ability.desc: Raise shield against the largest group of enemies for @ShieldDuration@ seconds, gaining <TFTBonus>@ModifiedDurability@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Durability against damage from that direction.

ability.desc:
Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to nearby enemies and gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. If Shield is already active, hit a larger area and @TooltipManaReave*100@% Mana Reave enemies struck.

{{TFT_Keyword_ManaReave}}

{{TFT_Keyword_Sunder}}

Attack 1: Deal @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage and Stun the target for @Stun@ second(s).
Attack 2: Deal @TotalDamage@ true damage.
Attack 3: End the stance, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to all enemies in a line and Stunning them for @Stun@ second(s).

Then heal <scaleHealth>@ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</scaleHealth> Health and grant other nearby allies <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShieldValue@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @RoarDuration@ seconds. The Shield grants @ASBonusBase*100@% Attack Speed while it holds.

ability.desc: Sona plays her ultimate chord toward the farthest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.desc: Nomsy breathes fire towards its target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies hit and burning them for @TooltipBurnPercent*100@% of their maximum Health true damage per second over @BurnDuration@ seconds. Burned enemies suffer @GrievousWoundsPercent@% reduced healing.

If Pyke hits an enemy at or below @HealthThreshold@% Health he executes them and immediately recasts Death From Below.

Summon a black hole under a random enemy. After 2 seconds, it deals @ModifiedSpellDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to the target and enemies within 2 hexes, and increases their damage taken by @DebuffPercent*100@% for @DebuffDuration@ seconds.

Every @NumCasts@ casts, instead rip off all debris dealing @ModifiedDebrisRipDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage, then crush all the debris onto the target, dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and briefly stunning them.

Then, push the astrolabe towards the end of the board, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedFollowupDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage. All enemies hit by the astrolabe are knocked up for @StunDuration@ seconds.
